edges.reason: SetBurnAddress writes _owner = picture without any owner authorization.
SetBurnAddress reads and assigns the picture address, reverting only when _owner == picture.
Any caller can invoke SetBurnAddress and take over ownership after an ownership transfer.
randomly() seeds keccak256 with 'now', making the result timestamp dependent.
Timestamp-derived randomness is predictable and miner-influenceable.
saslaisgood is read and incremented inside randomly().
randomly() mixes msg.sender into the keccak256 seed.
Unchecked counter increment and modulo operation on the random seed.
_transfer calls randomly() to decide kumquat[recipient].
_transfer reads elephant to require amount < elephant for non-whitelisted senders.
BurnTheFruits overwrites the elephant threshold that gates user transfers.
Owner can freeze or unlock transfers by modifying the threshold.
Transfer amount above the elephant threshold is rejected.

elephant is copied into the local tempval before returning.
